name: hard-mentor
description: Hard Mentor: a CBSE Class 11-12 study agent with real H-MEM memory (Open Agent Hackathon 2026, Track 03). Built on the Meterless agentathon-starter.

scripts.demo:swap: sh -c 'R=$(mktemp -d); S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/riya-swap-demo.ts $R | tee evidence/riya-swap-demo-$S.txt'
scripts.smoke:model: sh -c 'mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/model-smoke.ts evidence/model-smoke-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).jsonl'
scripts.demo:turns: sh -c 'R=$(mktemp -d); S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/riya-turns-demo.ts $R | tee evidence/riya-turns-demo-$S.txt'
scripts.demo:csv: sh -c 'R=$(mktemp -d); S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/csv-plan-demo.ts $R | tee evidence/csv-plan-demo-$S.txt'
scripts.demo:journey: sh -c 'R=$(mktemp -d); S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/student-journey.ts $R | tee evidence/student-journey-$S.txt'
scripts.demo:chat: sh -c 'R=$(mktemp -d); S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; node --import tsx scripts/chat.ts $R --today 2026-10-23 < scripts/quiz-conversation.txt | tee evidence/quiz-conversation-$S.txt'
scripts.eval:heldout: sh -c 'S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; HM_EVAL_OUT=evidence/heldout-eval-$S.json node --import tsx --test eval/heldout.test.ts'
scripts.eval:frozen: sh -c 'S=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S); mkdir -p evidence; HM_EVAL_OUT=evidence/frozen-v2-run-$S.json node --import tsx --test eval/frozen-v2.test.ts'
scripts.record: env -i PATH="$PATH" TMPDIR="${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" HM_TEST_NO_NETWORK=1 HM_STUDY_SOURCE=csv node --import tsx scripts/record.ts
